**Certificate.** 221 exact rational certificates in Evan Daniel's standard half-angle certificate format (`.cert`):
- Repository: [Mishapolk/square-packing-records](https://github.com/Mishapolk/square-packing-records)
- Pinned revision: [`1851c2c70a77085f2deb87978f10d40e0f0e86a6`](https://github.com/Mishapolk/square-packing-records/tree/1851c2c70a77085f2deb87978f10d40e0f0e86a6) (branch `main`)
- Directory: [`certificates/`](https://github.com/Mishapolk/square-packing-records/tree/1851c2c70a77085f2deb87978f10d40e0f0e86a6/certificates)
- Master victory ledger: [`SIGNIFICANT_VICTORIES.jsonl`](https://github.com/Mishapolk/square-packing-records/blob/1851c2c70a77085f2deb87978f10d40e0f0e86a6/SIGNIFICANT_VICTORIES.jsonl)

Each certificate file `certificates/<filename>` specifies the count n, the exact rational side fraction S, and for each square the exact rational centre coordinates (x, y) and half-angle rotation parameter t = tan(theta/2). All coordinates and side lengths are represented as exact fractions of arbitrary-precision integers (p/q).

Every certificate has strictly positive wall clearance and strictly positive separating axis gaps, satisfying both open-container and closed-container non-overlap conditions with zero tolerance.

**Checking.** Each certificate has been independently dual-checked with zero tolerance across independent verification engines:
1. `tools/competitors/evand/search/exact/verify_cert.py` (Evan Daniel exact rational separating hyperplane & container containment verifier): **221 / 221 passed (100% strictly positive clearance)**
2. `tools/jlevy_squares/packing/src/sqpack/verify.py` (Joshua Levy reference SQPACK verifier): **221 / 221 passed (100% exit code 0, zero mutual overlap)**

Commands to rerun verification:
```bash
python3 tools/competitors/evand/search/exact/verify_cert.py scratch/square-packing-records/certificates/n*.cert
python3 tools/jlevy_squares/packing/src/sqpack/verify.py scratch/square-packing-records/certificates/n*.cert
```

**What the checkers share.** `verify_cert.py` checks exact rational separating axes and wall containment. `sqpack/verify.py` is Joshua Levy's independent implementation. Both open-container margin conditions and closed-container non-overlap conditions are simultaneously satisfied with zero tolerance.

**Not done.** No claim of global optimality is made. No local rigidity or Karush–Kuhn–Tucker (KKT) second-order optimality is claimed for the perturbed rational witnesses. These establish constructive upper bounds on s(N).

**Lineage and credit.** Credit: Mishapolk (Mikhail Polk).
These packings build upon and refine foundational packings and discoveries by Erich Friedman, Joshua Levy, Evan Daniel, Francisco Couzo, Nate Chaoweeraprasit, Robert Barnett, Daniil Ostashev, Frits Goebel, and other contributors to the square packing record.

**AI assistance.** Gemini assisted with solver scripting, precision checks, and formatting.
